name: MedQA
intro: MedQA是一个来自美国、中国大陆和台湾医学执业考试的多语种四选一开放域医学问答数据集，共61,097题。论文同时构建18本英文和33本简体中文教材的OCR检索语料；题目与代码可在线获取，但教材权利须遵守论文所述的仅限研究使用许可边界。
org: MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Tongji Medical College at Huazhong University of Science and Technology
build_method: 医学执业考试题采集, 去重与选项规范化, 教材OCR语料
language: 英文、简体中文、繁体中文
task_type: 多项选择, 开放域问答
eval_feature: 多语种医学开放域问答, 教材检索, 来源独立准确率
build_method_en: Medical-board exam collection, deduplication and option normalization, textbook OCR corpus
eval_feature_en: Multilingual medical OpenQA, textbook retrieval, source-specific accuracy
intro_en: MedQA is a multilingual four-choice open-domain medical QA dataset with 61,097 questions from medical licensing exams in the United States, mainland China, and Taiwan. The paper also constructs OCR retrieval corpora from 18 English and 33 Simplified-Chinese textbooks; the questions and code are online, while textbook rights remain subject to the paper's research-use-only licensing boundary.

drawio_review_note: Paper/source alignment reviewed on 2026-07-21 against arXiv:2009.13081v1 (PDF SHA-256 5e19522f21c0ab5c24cc0dacd3feaa5d4b7057391520075f2e521a271d062ee6), official repository HEAD 27b02f66aac217933c9648a06f82e9f720377925, and the official Google Drive data_clean.zip file ID 1ImYUSLk9JbgHXOemfvyiDiirluZHPeQw (131,741,885 bytes; SHA-256 1c2ca8130b3d86d9a99a432ab9bef14f3bb9807bef20facd9ac86ba36960f629). The workflow preserves real and mock USMLE, MCMLE, and TWMLE collection; duplicate removal; question-level random 80/10/10 splitting; USMLE/MCMLE answer-order shuffling and random deletion of one wrong option; and the paper's separate TWMLE four-choice boundary. Exact train/dev/test counts are 10,178/1,272/1,273, 27,400/3,425/3,426, and 11,298/1,412/1,413. Archive inspection confirms those official split row counts and the question/options/answer/answer_idx/meta_info schema; the raw US and Mainland qbanks contain 14,369 and 34,253 rows respectively and must not be substituted for the official split totals. The textbook branch preserves 18 English books shared by USMLE/TWMLE, 33 Simplified-Chinese books for MCMLE, PDF-to-OCR conversion, cleanup and paragraph segmentation, and 231,581 English plus 116,216 Chinese paragraphs. Table 5 coverage (two M.D.s, 100 development questions per source, 88%/100%/87%) is separated from the later two-doctor top-25 retrieval diagnostic and neither filters the release nor enters the score. The paper translates TWMLE from Traditional Chinese to English with Google Translation and reports accuracy separately, with best test results of 36.7% USMLE, 70.1% MCMLE, and 42.0% TWMLE. The released repository does not provide a generic model evaluator: its pinned textsearch.py (SHA-256 f23d7ccaef21180f2aad26f29dda6d9282f7527eadea3b2a86845b85d87b1264) is an Elasticsearch 2.4.1 IR baseline that queries question plus each option, sums top-N BM25 scores (default N=1), selects the first strictly greater positive maximum, compares its label with answer_idx, and prints correct/all parsed rows × 100. Missing fields or all-zero scores are not converted into scored invalid outputs and can abort. The 2022 MIT LICENSE covers repository code; the Drive archive has no README/LICENSE, and the paper says textbooks are released upon a research-use-only license agreement. No dataset DOI, tagged release, generic output parser, composite metric, or official live leaderboard is claimed. Formal publication evidence [site-a11t-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3035×1505 (English) and 3032×1505 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3033×1503 and 3030×1503. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
